description: Normative vectors for the Room Ghosts read route, GET /api/mansions/{mansion}/specs/{spec}/room-ghosts (schema_version 1). Every 'valid' value must be accepted unchanged by the UI parser (app/ui/src/core/room-projection.ts) and is a shape the backend serializer may emit; every 'invalid' value differs from a valid one in one respect and must be refused at 'refused_at'. All values are synthetic.

artifact.content:
# Requirements Document

## Introduction

A guest book that keeps entries in the order they were written.

## Requirements

### Requirement 1: Keep entries

1. WHEN a guest signs, THE Guest_Book SHALL store the entry.
2. THE Guest_Book SHALL keep entries in insertion order.
